script.speaker: Councillor
script.text: Our survey shows residents want to recycle, yet a quarter of collected material is contaminated.

script.text: Air readings are highest during the morning drop-off, so we propose closing the road for forty minutes.

script.text: You argue that remote work can strengthen small towns. Isn’t isolation a serious drawback?

Everyone should work alone at home

questions.prompt: Why does Beth favour shared workspaces?

options.text: They combine social contact with local spending
They remove the need for cafés

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 共享工作間既減少孤立，也為附近商戶帶來顧客。

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Your topic is the return of museum objects. Do you think every object should go back to its country of origin?

questions.prompt: What concern does he have about long-term loans?

options.text: They may leave unequal ownership unchanged

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 借展可能看似解決，實際仍維持不平等擁有權。

questions.prompt: Who should be consulted first?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他強調先與相關社群對話。

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: You say public transport should be free. Wouldn’t that be unfair to people who rarely use it?

script.text: I understand the objection, but roads are also funded by people who do not drive. The wider benefit is less congestion and cleaner air.

questions.prompt: What objection does the examiner raise?

questions.explanation_zh_hk: Lina 說免費車資必須配合頻密可靠班次。

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: If your local market closed, how might the area change?

options.text: A shared playlist is a different condition

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 集體播放與實驗條件不同，不能直接推論。

County-wide sourcing makes the village claim false
Customers should choose only cheese made from village milk

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 「村內製造」雖然屬實，仍可能令人誤以為牛奶亦來自村內；補充來源可避免誤解。

questions.prompt: What information will clarify the label?

options.text: The farm name without the dairy
The dairy name without the milk’s origin
The dairy and the milk’s origin

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 標籤會說明乳品廠及牛奶來源。

script.speaker: Molly
script.text: I remember our primary classroom as enormous, but I visited recently and it seemed quite small.

script.speaker: Hassan
script.text: You were much smaller then. Your memory of the space may be accurate from a child’s perspective.

script.speaker: Molly
script.text: Possibly. The windows have changed too, so I cannot assume everything is exactly as it was.

script.speaker: Hassan
script.text: A photograph from that time might help, although it would show only one angle.

questions.prompt: What surprised Molly on her visit?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 重訪時課室比她記憶中小。

questions.prompt: How does Hassan explain her memory?

options.text: The room must have been rebuilt

questions.explanation_zh_hk: Hassan 認為孩童體型較小，感受空間大小的角度不同。

questions.prompt: What limit does Hassan mention about a photograph?

options.text: It could confirm the room’s exact dimensions
It would show only the new windows

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 一張相片只顯示單一角度。

script.speaker: Manager
script.text: We throw away more prepared sandwiches on Mondays than on any other day.

script.speaker: Cook
script.text: Monday sales vary because nearby offices have different attendance patterns each week.

script.speaker: Manager
script.text: Instead of a fixed quantity, let us prepare a smaller first batch and make more if demand rises.

script.speaker: Cook
script.text: That could reduce waste, provided we monitor whether customers have to wait too long.

questions.prompt: Why is a fixed Monday quantity problematic?

options.text: Monday demand is always higher than expected
Office workers no longer buy sandwiches

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 附近辦公室每星期的出勤情況不同，令星期一銷量不穩定，固定製作數量容易造成浪費。

questions.prompt: What production change is proposed?

options.text: Prepare all Monday sandwiches on Sunday
Prepare the same larger batch every Monday

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 建議先做較少數量，有需求再增加。

questions.prompt: What should be monitored during the change?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 廚師提醒須留意顧客會否等太久。

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: You propose more seating in the town square. How would you answer people who fear it will obstruct events?

script.speaker: Grace
script.text: The seats need not be permanent. Movable benches could be rearranged when a market or performance takes place.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Would movable furniture create any difficulties?

script.speaker: Grace
script.text: Storage and maintenance would cost money, so the council should test a few benches before buying a full set.

questions.prompt: How does Grace address the concern about events?

options.text: Move every event to another venue
Keep permanent benches around each stall

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 可移動長椅能在活動時重新安排。

questions.prompt: What drawback does Grace acknowledge?

options.text: Events would have to stop during the trial

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 她承認儲存及維修需要費用。

questions.prompt: What does her proposed trial suggest?

options.text: She has abandoned the seating proposal
She believes a full set would cost nothing
She wants to assess practical costs before committing

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 她建議先試用少量長椅，反映她希望了解實際儲存及維修需要，再決定是否全面購置。

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: You said technology makes people less sociable. Do you think that is always true?

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: No, I should qualify that. Video calls help my family stay in touch across countries.

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: Then what concerns you?

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: When people check their phones throughout a meal, those present may feel ignored. The effect depends on how technology is used.

questions.prompt: How does Dev revise his original claim?

options.text: It applies to video calls in particular
It is true whenever families live apart

questions.explanation_zh_hk: Dev 收窄原先的說法，承認並非總是如此。

questions.prompt: What benefit does he mention?

options.text: Phones improve conversation at every meal
Technology prevents families from moving apart

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 視像通話幫助身處不同國家的家人保持聯繫。

questions.prompt: What determines the effect in Dev’s view?

options.text: Whether contact happens face to face

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他認為影響取決於使用方式。

script.speaker: Organiser
script.text: The Saturday repair workshop is full, but we have a waiting list in case anyone cancels.

script.speaker: Attendee
script.text: I can only attend in the morning. Would being on the list commit me to the whole day?

script.speaker: Organiser
script.text: No. We will contact you if a place opens, and you can decide then. The morning session covers bicycles.

script.speaker: Attendee
script.text: Please add me. If no place becomes available, I will use the online guide instead.

questions.prompt: Why is there a waiting list?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 工作坊已滿，候補名單用於有人取消時。

questions.prompt: What does joining the waiting list involve?

options.text: A guaranteed place in the morning session
An opportunity to accept a place later
A commitment to attend the whole day

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 候補名單只提供日後接受空位的機會，並不保證有位，也不要求參加全日。

questions.prompt: What is the attendee’s alternative?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 若沒有空位，參加者會使用網上指南。

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Your presentation was well researched, but the audience struggled to follow the final section.

script.speaker: Student
script.text: I added several statistics at the last minute. Was the slide too crowded?

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Partly. More importantly, you did not explain how the figures supported your conclusion.

script.speaker: Student
script.text: I will select fewer figures and make that connection explicit when I revise it.

questions.prompt: What did the audience struggle with?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 聽眾難以跟上最後部分。

questions.prompt: What was the main issue with the figures?

options.text: Their link to the conclusion was unexplained

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 導師最關注數據與結論的關係沒有解釋。

questions.prompt: How will the student revise?

options.text: Use fewer figures and explain their relevance

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 學生會精選數據並說明其關聯。

script.speaker: Lena
script.text: Your aunt has invited me to dinner and I thought I would bring flowers. Is that appropriate?

script.speaker: Harish
script.text: Usually, but my aunt is allergic to strong scents. Something edible might be easier.

script.speaker: Lena
script.text: I could bring biscuits, though I should ask whether anyone has dietary restrictions.

script.speaker: Harish
script.text: That is considerate. Asking beforehand is more useful than guessing what a host expects.

questions.prompt: Why might flowers be unsuitable?

options.text: The host has a scent allergy
The host has a dietary restriction
The host expects guests to bring biscuits

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 女主人對濃烈香味敏感。

questions.prompt: What will Lena check about biscuits?

options.text: Whether every guest prefers sweet gifts
Whether the host expects expensive brands

questions.explanation_zh_hk: Lena 會先詢問有沒有飲食限制。

questions.prompt: What principle does Harish favour?

options.text: Assume edible gifts are always suitable
Bring the same gift to every host

questions.explanation_zh_hk: Harish 認為預先詢問比猜測更周到。

script.speaker: Owner
script.text: We are introducing refill containers for cleaning liquid. Customers pay a deposit for the bottle.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Does that mean I must return it to this branch?

script.speaker: Owner
script.text: Any of our branches will accept it. The deposit is returned even if you decide not to refill.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: That makes the scheme more flexible. Clear signs would help people understand the deposit is refundable.

questions.prompt: Where can the bottle be returned?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 任何一間該店分店都接受退瓶。

questions.prompt: What does the owner clarify about the deposit?

options.text: It can only be used as credit for another refill
A refill purchase is not required for a refund
It can be refunded only at the original branch

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 退瓶時即使不再補充清潔液，按金仍會退還。

questions.prompt: Why does the customer want clear signs?

options.text: To explain that the deposit is refundable
To explain why returns are branch-specific
To encourage customers to buy another bottle

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 清晰標示可讓顧客知道按金可退。

script.speaker: Researcher
script.text: Our survey found that sixty per cent of respondents supported the proposed cycle lane.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: Can I say sixty per cent of all residents support it?

script.speaker: Researcher
script.text: Not safely. The survey was voluntary and may not represent residents who did not respond.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: I will report the figure as a share of respondents and mention that limitation. We can gather further evidence before the decision.

questions.prompt: Who made up the sixty per cent?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 百分之六十的基數是調查回應者。

questions.prompt: Why should the result not be generalised automatically?

options.text: Voluntary respondents may not represent everyone
Sixty per cent is too small a majority to report
Only surveys with unanimous answers are useful

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 自願回應者可能不能代表所有居民。

questions.prompt: How will the presenter describe the figure?

options.text: As a proven share of all residents
As a share of all local cyclists

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 發表者會清楚指出比例來自回應者。

questions.prompt: What can they do before the decision?

options.text: Treat the survey as a binding vote

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他們可在決定前收集更多證據。
